rule: child: median finish >= 380 s on any setting, or >= 20 put-backs a run on Easy; expert: median finish <= 190 s and <= 1.0 lives + put-backs a run; middle: everyone else with a finished gen2 1-1 run; unrated: no finished run
thinRule: thin: a tier under 10 runs; a player under 5 gen2 runs or with touchPlacedShare under 0.8: sample, do not trust its tails
note: pooled over runs; perPlayer keeps one player from counting as many
